reason: The PR fixes a JIT fastpass bug where a swallowed issue's value leaked into the result; at base the absent optional key still appears with the leaked value, violating the expectation.
After the PR the JIT branch guards both issue concat and value assignment on presence, so an absent optional key is dropped cleanly.
At base a tab-only line is swallowed as a lazy continuation so the two paragraphs merge into one; the fix widens the blank-line lookahead to include tabs.
The paragraph continuation lookahead now treats a tab-only line as blank, producing two distinct paragraph elements.
The JSON response parsing is standard axios behavior and the stack-decoration change only affects the error path, so the request still resolves to a parsed object.
Same unrelated change; successful JSON responses are unaffected by the stack-decoration fix.
Boolean flag parsing is core commander functionality, unrelated to the uppercase-E negative-number change.
Same; the negative-number regex change does not affect boolean flag recognition.
At base JsonTreeReader.nextInt goes straight to Integer.parseInt which coerces full-width digits to 123; the test expects a parsing error.
The PR adds validateAscii for string tokens in JsonTreeReader, so full-width digits now raise MalformedJsonException.
At base the alphanumeric-only regex splits 'test-db' into 'test' and 'db'; the test expects a single schema name.
The new blocklist regex keeps the hyphen so 'test-db' is applied as one schema name.
The ByteBufferUtil resource-leak fix is unrelated to ImageView transformation eligibility, so the default transform behavior is unchanged.
Same unrelated change; transformations remain applied by default.
Caching the allowed-symbols CharacterSet is behavior-preserving; identifiers with allowed symbols still pass.
Same; the cached set yields identical results to the rebuilt union.
The <cstdint> include is a compile fix unrelated to SVG data-URI decoding; the image still loads.
The Afrikaans locale addition is unrelated to DST-aware datetime shifting; shift still works correctly.
Same <cstdint> change; SVG percent-encoded data URI loading is unaffected.
The cookie-header parsing fix is unrelated to form-urlencoded body decoding; empty-body decode still succeeds.
Same; cookie parsing does not affect form decoding of an empty body.
The spelling fix is unrelated to filesystem Remove semantics; removing a non-empty dir still returns an error.
Same; the spelling changes do not alter Remove behavior.
The test describes an index-rename ambiguity bug (undefined array key) that the JSON-flag test change does not touch; the warning likely persists.
Same; the JSON-flag change is unrelated to schema comparator index rename handling.
The Afrikaans locale change is unrelated to datetime shift; DST-aware shifting still works correctly at base.
The CircuitBreaker permit-leak fix is unrelated to the rate limiter's scheduled replenishment; behavior is unchanged.
Same; the rate limiter is a different component unaffected by the circuit breaker change.
The prefer-template ASI fix is unrelated to the no-var autofix rule; hoisting semantics are unchanged.
Same; the var->block-scoped autofix still preserves hoisting behavior.
The log-formatter fix is unrelated to sitemap spider resume; resumption behavior is unchanged.
Same; log formatting does not affect spider job persistence.
The --sanitize bidi-control change is unrelated to double-width rendering at width 1; behavior is unchanged.
Same; sanitize preprocessing does not affect row-background rendering.
The RFC5424 regex optimization is unrelated to the file output plugin's symlink creation; behavior is unchanged.
Same; syslog parser regex does not affect symlink updates.
The ConcurrentBag virtual-thread change is unrelated to pool-name generation; construction behavior is unchanged.
Same; pool-name generation does not acquire a shared system-properties lock in either revision.
The SORT ACL fix is unrelated to 32-bit BGSAVE persistence; background save still succeeds.
Same; ACL key checks do not affect background save behavior.
The CWD fix is unrelated to CTRL-A number incrementing; behavior is unchanged.
Same; the CWD bookkeeping change does not affect CTRL-X decrement.
The file-cache race fix is unrelated to array || NULL type inference; behavior is unchanged.
Same; type inference for list concat is unaffected.
The ScrollBar drag fix is unrelated to RefCounted NOTIFICATION_PREDELETE; behavior is unchanged.
Same; the scroll input change does not affect refcount notification.
The DecisionTree categorical absolute_error change is unrelated to f_regression; behavior is unchanged.
Same; r_regression is unaffected by the tree criterion validation.
The Swagger UI readonly fix is unrelated to Vault Agent file sink permissions; behavior is unchanged.
Same; the file sink mode is unaffected by the UI change.
At base write_usage with empty args emits only a blank line, so the first line is not 'Usage: cli'.
The PR writes the prefix and program name even with no args and strips the trailing space, yielding 'Usage: cli'.
The IPv6 partition fix is unrelated to dict-to-JSON response handling; the response is still serialized as JSON.
Same; response JSON serialization is unaffected.
The unhashable-alias fix is unrelated to required-field validation; omitting a required field still errors.
Same; required-field validation is unchanged.
WARN and WARNING are the same numeric level, so the rename is a no-op; echo-off still suppresses SQL logs.
Same; the level rename does not change echo behavior.
The thread-safety method_missing change adds minor overhead but the 20x threshold is very loose; computed attribute access stays inexpensive.
Same; the ratio remains well under 20x after the change.
At base getCalledListeners reads the accumulating callStack, reporting one entry per invocation (count 2).
The PR deduplicates called listeners so the same listener dispatched twice is reported once, not the two entries the test expects.
The shellcheck COMPREPLY refactor is unrelated to custom subcommand completion; scoped values are still returned correctly.
Same; custom completion hooks still identify the active subcommand.
qs defaults to arrayLimit 20, so 25 repeated keys become an object keyed by index rather than an array.
The qs 6.13->6.14 bump does not change arrayLimit, so the behavior is unchanged.
At base get_environ_proxies accepts a single URL argument and works.
The PR makes no_proxy a required positional argument, so a single-argument call raises TypeError.
The parse_unit_value change only affects valid unit suffixes; '.foons' is not a unit and still parses as a string.
Same; '.foons' remains a bare-word string at head.
At base a HEAD request with a sink and Accept-Encoding gzip can fail; the test expects it to complete.
The PR skips connecting a sink for HEAD requests, so the request completes successfully.
The map-in-list formatting change is unrelated to an improper list inside a map; the match failure formats without crashing.
Same; the improper-list map assertion still produces a standard match error.
At base the dynamic css-props component teardown removes the element/hydration fails, so the red color is lost after toggle.
The PR removes the teardown and fixes dynamic component css_props hydration, preserving the CSS custom property.
At base the string-includes check handles multi-line new URL references, so the asset is emitted.
The new filter regex /new\s+URL.+import\.meta\.url/ does not match across newlines, so multi-line references are no longer bundled.
At base no FZF_CURRENT_ITEM is exported, so the NUL-containing item does not break the preview child process.
The PR exports FZF_CURRENT_ITEM with the NUL-containing item text, which can break spawning the preview command.
At base switching to edge-to-edge reuses deprecated LAYOUT flags that do not properly restore the system bars.
The PR uses WindowCompat to properly manage edge-to-edge state, restoring the bars.
At base there is no multiple-assignment check, so ClassLabel(num_classes=num_classes) reports no error.
The visitor inserts the keyword attr name and the bound pattern name, flagging the valid pattern as a duplicate assignment.
At base decoding two blocks into a length-1 slice panics with index out of range.
The PR grows the destination slice as needed, producing exactly two entries.
At base setTestNow with an LA moment returns it in LA timezone, not the default UTC.
The PR falls back to date_default_timezone_get, so the mocked now is presented in UTC.
At base the regex only matches exactly two leading slashes, missing ///test.com, tab-separated, and mixed slash forms.
The expanded regex recognizes all three protocol-relative forms.
The getBytesInternal micro-optimization produces identical values; MD5 of 'abc' is unaffected.
Same; the MD5 digest is unchanged.
Moving diagnostic descriptors is a pure refactor; source generation still produces a working GET client.
Same; generated client behavior is unchanged.
Removing redundant continue statements does not change control flow; HTTP/1.1 body fetch still works.
Same; body reading is unaffected.
At base to_iso8601 with :basic on a non-ISO calendar silently returns the :extended form.
The PR passes the requested format through after converting to the ISO calendar.
At base setEndDate leaves the native end property stale on PHP 8.2+.
The PR re-synchronizes the native DatePeriod so end reports the new value.
At base the client transmits a request line with an embedded newline instead of rejecting it.
The PR raises RequestError before sending when the path or host contains whitespace.
The Albanian locale change is unrelated to English number-to-words; English pluralization is unchanged.
Same; English 'one million'/'two million' output is unaffected.
The property-loading fix is unrelated to singleton scope; resolving twice returns the same instance.
Same; singleton resolution is unaffected.
The shared replace primitive is behavior-preserving; replaceElement and duplicate-key precondition are unchanged.
Same; the refactored replace preserves order and duplicate-key rejection.
Replacing the manual clamp with builtin max is equivalent; '-5MB' still yields 0.
Same; the max() call clamps negative sizes to zero identically.
At base findCaseInsensitivePathRec grabs children[0] and panics when a node has both static and wildcard children.
The PR prefers static children via indices and falls back to the wildcard child at the end, avoiding the panic.
At base Int64Value dereferences a nil Int and panics for a valid Numeric with nil Int.
The PR guards toBigInt to return zero when Int is nil.
The tab-stop renderer fix is unrelated to quit handling; external quit still returns promptly.
Same; the run loop still returns after quit.
At base the already-cancelled token still polls the wrapped future, which panics.
The PR checks cancellation first, returning None without polling the future.
The ignore-file loading optimization is unrelated to case-insensitive matching; matches are still found.
Same; case-insensitive search results are unaffected.
The nesting removal is behavior-preserving; skip_deserializing still defaults the field.
Same; the skipped field still receives its type's default.
